recipes.name: Goji Berry and Pork-Eye Casserole
ingredients: 30 g goji berries; 2 pairs pork eyes; 100 g longan flesh; 15 g Shanzhuyu.
recipes.steps: Rinse the berries and Shanzhuyu and put them in a cloth pouch. Clean the pork eyes. Fry ginger and garlic in a little lard. Add the eyes, longan, cooking wine, salt and water. recipes.name: Walnut and Black Sesame Milk Mixture
ingredients: 1,000 g walnuts and 500 g black sesame for a batch; 1 cup milk or soy milk and 1 spoon honey per serving, as described in the source.
recipes.steps: Shell and skin the walnuts, lightly toast and crush into a paste. Wash and dry-toast the sesame and grind finely. The source mixes one spoon of each with boiled milk or soy milk, then adds honey after cooling. This is an archived preparation, not a prescribed daily dose.
